meaning:
μή-τε
negative particle, differing from οὔτε as μή from οὐ, neither, nor: μήτε . . . μήτε, neither . . .
nor, Mat.11:18, Luk.7:33 9:3, Act.23:12, 21 27:20, Heb.7:3; μὴ (μηδὲ) . . . μήτε . . . μήτε, Mat.5:34, 36, Mrk.3:20 T, Act.23:8, 2Th.2:2, 1Ti.1:7, Jas.5:12, Rev.7:1, 3.†
(AS)
